author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: Hiring freelance artists for character, background, and game art
content: HIRING LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS. Avetetsuya Studios saat ini membuka kesempatan bagi freelance artist untuk berkolaborasi dalam berbagai proyek mendatang. Kami mencari artist yang memiliki kemampuan dalam: Character Design & Illustration; Character Sprites; Background & Environment Art; Webtoon / Comic Artwork; Game & Digital Art Assets; Ilustrasi dan visual development lainnya. Kualifikasi: portofolio yang kuat, mampu mengikuti art direction, anatomi/komposisi/warna, deadline, feedback/revisi, komunikasi profesional. Cara Melamar: kirimkan portofolio dan perkenalan singkat ke avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com. Subject: Freelance Artist Application – [Nama Anda]. Include artwork types, art style, availability, and freelance rate. Selected artists will be contacted for upcoming freelance projects.
